Q423.reason: Intent to inflict only a slight wound lacks malice for murder, so the unintended death from an unlawful act is involuntary manslaughter.

Q424.reason: At common law the tenant for years bore the duty to make ordinary repairs, so he is liable for failing to repair the roof after the leak appeared.

Q425.reason: Phlebitis causes warmth, not coolness, so 'cool to the touch' is the sign that does not fit.
